nom: Peter Thomas Roth Potent-C Niacinamide Discoloration Treatment

segments.dry: One reviewer describes her skin as dry, aging, and prone to sun damage and spots, and reports the combined vitamin C and niacinamide formula protects, brightens, and makes her pores look smaller.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive or sensitive, acne-prone skin report no burning, redness, or irritation, even applying twice daily, though most build up to daily use gradually at first.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her early senior years, who had taken a long break from skincare, reports the treatment eliminated the textured, porous look her older skin had developed, giving a smoother, glassier surface after even a single overnight use, though she notes it does not address lifting or wrinkles.

concerns.aging: A few reviewers note incidental anti-aging benefits such as smoother texture, smaller-looking pores, and softer fine lines, though one reviewer specifically notes it does not address skin lifting or deeper wrinkles.
concerns.dehydration: One reviewer describes the treatment as hydrating as well as brightening, though this is the only reviewer to comment on hydration directly.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with sensitive skin report no redness or irritation, even those normally cautious with active ingredients like vitamin C.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers report visible fading of dark spots, sun spots, and post-acne marks, in some cases within a week and often described as dramatic; however, two reviewers report no improvement at all even after two to six months of consistent use.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers use this specifically on post-acne marks and scarring and report faster fading than usual, including one whose fresh breakout mark faded unusually quickly.

aspects.libelle: Lightweight texture, absorbs quickly without pilling
Reformulation added alcohol and titanium dioxide
No stinging despite high vitamin C concentration
Cheaper than buying two separate PTR actives

extraits.texte: This is a poor replacement for the old peter thomas roth pro strength niacinamide discoloration treatment. Now including skin sensitinzing alcohol and titanium dioxide that can cause nanoparticles to accumolate in the body.
I have been using this for over 6 months and I have seen no improvement at all in my dark spots.

I was gifted this product by Peter Thomas Roth for my honest review . As someone that suffers from severe hyper pigmentation, I have yet to find a product that helped. The Potent-C Niacinamide Discoloration Treatment did not disappoint! I have sensitive acne prone skin and once my acne is gone, I'm left with awful dark spots. Since I started using the product, my skin tone has improved significantly! I used this product night and day and haven't had any side effects. I highly recommend this product!

I love this product. Fantastic results. I'm an "early" senior and haven't been doing any skin care for a number of years, just took a break. Older skin in a magnifying mirror gets that textured look and the pores versus when in our 20's the skin has that smooth perfect glass surface look. This product did more than any other products to eliminate that texture and pores and it produces that glassy look. It also smoothed little bumps under the eyes. That's just from one over night treatment. Did not expect the "glassy" surface skin results like this. Bought a bunch of product, as I used PTR in the past and loved the Potent C line, but never tried this product. Of course, for lifting or wrinkles something else is required; but, for older women with the "textured" skin and the usual pores, this product is absolutely amazing! Love it !

I have some sun spots on my cheeks as well as some minor scarring that I would really like to fade. This was gifted by Peter Thomas Roth in exchange for an honest review. I'm still building up to daily use with this treatment but so far so good! I have pretty sensitive skin but this serum hasn't led to any redness or reactions. It is fragrance free; it feels gentle and goes on smoothly.

extraits.titre: Great for post acne dark spots!
extraits.texte: This is such a great product for post acne marks, I have always suffered with post acne marks and they take so long to get better. Some days ago I got a huge pimple in my jaw and it leave a dark spot behind, I decided to use this product and try how effective it is and it seems it definetely works for such purpose. Acne spot post inflammation was reduced super fast and the dark spot faded so much faster than usual that I was really amazed by it. My skin also looks brighter and healthier overall. Complimentary from Peterthomasroth, but that does't affect in any way my honest review about the product.

extraits.titre: Vit C and Niacinamide in one
extraits.texte: I love everything Potent-C line from Peter Thomas Roth and this Niacinamide Discoloration Treatment is not an exception. I have dry, aging, prone to sun damage and spots skin and Vitamin C with Niacinamide in one is the best solution for my kind of skin. It's protects, brightens and makes my pores look smaller. Gifted by PTR
